name: Twelve Permissions #08 — THE POST
description: TO ASK WHY NOT ME. A coworker showed me a post. A well-known man, an AI agent, and a robot dog. Minted, sold, delivered, paid for by the machine. My first thought was that it was very cool. My second was that I wondered whether I could do it too. I am just delusional enough to believe I can. Evidence: A public post describing an agent that minted and sold NFTs and funded a robot.
